title: SonarCloud rejected the original Traefik UDS hardening because public-root allocation was on the PR path
title_de: SonarCloud wies die ursprüngliche Traefik-UDS-Härtung zurück, weil Public-Root-Allokation im PR-Pfad lag
summary: The first SonarCloud analysis of Parent Draft PR #51 failed its new-code Security Rating (D). Direct raw PR evidence classified public-root UDS allocation/fallback code, a generic inherited TMPDIR selector, and a process-global umask as vulnerabilities. The first post-remediation exact-head check closed 14 task-owned issues; the final implementation requires an explicit private parent and preserves named lifecycle values as raw environment data. Exact head 6e73dc97eba8b503d7d88f7feb3c43ef14132083 then passed SonarCloud with zero new issues and an A security rating, without suppression or risk acceptance.
summary_de: Die erste SonarCloud-Analyse des Parent-Draft-PR #51 scheiterte am New-Code-Security-Rating (D). Direkte rohe PR-Evidence klassifizierte Public-Root-UDS-Allokation/Fallback-Code, einen generischen geerbten TMPDIR-Selector und eine prozessglobale umask als Vulnerabilities. Der erste Post-Remediation-Exact-Head-Check schloss 14 task-owned Issues; die finale Implementierung verlangt einen expliziten privaten Parent und bewahrt benannte Lifecycle-Werte als rohe Environment-Daten. Exact Head 6e73dc97eba8b503d7d88f7feb3c43ef14132083 bestand anschließend SonarCloud mit null neuen Issues und Security-Rating A, ohne Suppression oder Risikoakzeptanz.

The first post-remediation exact-head check, 87949565401 for 56e35eb5e6ff52e0ec84f08807f767acc890ae9e, closed 14 task-owned issues. Its only open vulnerability was python:S5443 at the runner's inherited TMPDIR fallback; no scanner control was changed. The subsequent head 2ad97e0e4c7defd0d7d0aa30b8603d59dacbed85 exposed thirteen test-fixture-only python:S5443 annotations for hard-coded /tmp injection values. The focused follow-up derives those fixture paths from a private TemporaryDirectory; final exact head 6e73dc97eba8b503d7d88f7feb3c43ef14132083 passed check 87978528103 with zero annotations, zero open PR issues, and Quality Gate status OK.

expected_behavior: The runner, shell harness, and C engine must require an existing, absolute, canonical, current-user-owned, exact-0700 non-symlink socket parent whose full ancestor chain prevents cross-UID replacement before binding or allocating a UDS child. The native runner accepts only the explicit TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT and must not select a generic inherited temporary-directory variable. The listener must not rely on a process-global umask or pathname chmod for that boundary, and a re-run on the updated exact PR head must satisfy the SonarCloud new-code Security Rating gate without a suppression or risk acceptance.
expected_behavior_de: Runner, Shell-Harness und C-Engine müssen vor Bind oder Allokation eines UDS-Childs einen bestehenden, absoluten, kanonischen, current-user-owned, exakt-0700 und symlinkfreien Socket-Parent verlangen, dessen vollständige Vorfahrenkette UID-übergreifende Ersetzung verhindert. Der native Runner akzeptiert nur den expliziten TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT und darf keine generische geerbte Temporary-Directory-Variable wählen. Der Listener darf sich für diese Grenze nicht auf eine prozessglobale umask oder pathname chmod stützen, und ein Rerun auf dem aktualisierten exakten PR-Head muss das SonarCloud-New-Code-Security-Rating-Gate ohne Suppression oder Risikoakzeptanz erfüllen.
impact: The exact Draft-PR head now satisfies its configured external security gate, but the finding remains fixed rather than verified or closed because no master integration is authorized or performed. In the pre-remediation implementation, an elevated or otherwise sensitive native runner inheriting an attacker-selected absolute TMPDIR could create a named UDS child below a parent outside the intended private boundary. The scanner evidence does not validate the separate same-UID endpoint-redirection or final-cleanup races; those remain FND-PARENT-0013, FND-PARENT-0014, and FND-PARENT-0015.
impact_de: Der exakte Draft-PR-Head erfüllt jetzt sein konfiguriertes externes Security-Gate, aber das Finding bleibt fixed statt verified oder closed, weil keine Master-Integration autorisiert oder durchgeführt ist. Im Vorzustand könnte ein privilegierter oder anderweitig sensibler nativer Runner, der ein angreiferkontrolliertes absolutes TMPDIR erbt, ein benanntes UDS-Child außerhalb der beabsichtigten privaten Grenze erzeugen. Die Scanner-Evidence validiert nicht die separaten Same-UID-Endpoint-Umleitungs- oder Final-Cleanup-Races; diese bleiben FND-PARENT-0013, FND-PARENT-0014 und FND-PARENT-0015.

root_cause: The prior implementation retained automatic public-root fallback allocation in the Python runner and the C self-test accepted inherited TMPDIR with only an absolute-path check before falling back to /var/tmp. It also used a temporary process-global umask for a pathname socket boundary where the verified control is instead the private parent. The first remediation review additionally proved that immediate-parent-only checks accepted a parent beneath a non-sticky cross-UID-writable ancestor. The first exact-head reanalysis proved that the generic Python TMPDIR fallback was the sole remaining active vulnerability, so the final source follow-up removes that optional selector rather than relying on later manual validation. Once that selection is strict, the supported dispatcher and Make chain must preserve the caller's value; deriving one below the canonical runtime or temporary root would exceed the 100-byte UDS path budget. The external Quality Gate failure is confirmed; whether every scanner classification maps to a separately exploitable product vulnerability remains bounded by the source and runtime evidence stated here.
root_cause_de: Die vorherige Implementierung behielt automatische Public-Root-Fallback-Allokation im Python-Runner, und der C-Selbsttest akzeptierte geerbtes TMPDIR nur mit absoluter Pfadprüfung, bevor er auf /var/tmp zurückfiel. Außerdem verwendete sie eine temporäre prozessglobale umask für eine Pathname-Socket-Grenze, deren verifizierte Kontrolle stattdessen der private Parent ist. Die erste Remediation-Review bewies zusätzlich, dass Immediate-Parent-only-Checks einen Parent unter einem nicht-sticky UID-übergreifend beschreibbaren Vorfahren akzeptierten. Die erste Exact-Head-Reanalyse bewies, dass der generische Python-TMPDIR-Fallback die einzige verbleibende aktive Vulnerability war; der finale Source-Follow-up entfernt daher diesen optionalen Selector statt sich auf eine spätere manuelle Validierung zu stützen. Sobald diese Auswahl strikt ist, muss die unterstützte Dispatcher- und Make-Kette den Aufruferwert erhalten; einen unter dem kanonischen Runtime- oder Temporary-Root abzuleiten würde das 100-Byte-UDS-Pfadbudget überschreiten. Der externe Quality-Gate-Fehler ist bestätigt; ob jede Scanner-Klassifikation einer separat ausnutzbaren Produktvulnerability entspricht, bleibt durch die hier benannte Source- und Runtime-Evidence begrenzt.
proposed_remediation: Replace public-root/default allocation with explicitly supplied existing private parents; enforce absolute, canonical, current-user-owned, exact-0700 non-symlink checks and a cross-UID-safe ancestor chain in the runner, C listener, C self-test, and shell harness; require only TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT in the production runner instead of inheriting TMPDIR; make the canonical dispatcher and native Make target forward only that caller-supplied exact value rather than deriving one below a runtime or temporary root; remove global umask reliance and avoid pathname chmod claims; preserve fail-closed behavior; then rerun security and legitimate controls and the external PR analysis.
proposed_remediation_de: Public-Root-/Standardallokation durch explizit bereitgestellte bestehende private Parents ersetzen; absolute, kanonische, current-user-owned, exakt-0700 und symlinkfreie Checks sowie eine UID-übergreifend sichere Vorfahrenkette im Runner, C-Listener, C-Selbsttest und Shell-Harness erzwingen; im Produktions-Runner nur TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT verlangen, statt TMPDIR zu erben; den kanonischen Dispatcher und das native Make-Target nur diesen aufrufergelieferten exakten Wert weiterreichen lassen, statt einen unter einem Runtime- oder Temporary-Root abzuleiten; globale umask-Abhängigkeit entfernen und Pathname-chmod-Behauptungen vermeiden; Fail-Closed-Verhalten erhalten; danach Security- und legitime Kontrollen sowie die externe PR-Analyse erneut ausführen.
acceptance_criteria: No production runner or C self-test silently allocates a UDS parent beneath /tmp or /var/tmp.
The production runner does not accept a generic inherited temporary-directory fallback and requires TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT before host setup.
The canonical dispatcher and native Make target preserve only the caller-supplied exact parent and do not derive one below a runtime or temporary root.
An absent, relative, symlinked, foreign-owned, or non-0700 socket parent fails before UDS allocation or bind.
The listener relies on the verified private-parent/ancestor boundary; no global umask wrapper or pathname chmod claim remains.
Focused C17 build, native UDS runtime, Python runner contracts, C++ evaluator controls, and legitimate Allow/Blocking cases pass.
The updated PR head has no active task-owned SonarCloud vulnerability finding from this remediation and its new-code Security Rating meets the configured threshold.
No scanner suppression, Quality-Gate configuration change, automatic risk acceptance, H3 work, Framework work, MRTS modification, or merge occurs.

history.detail: Direct GitHub and SonarCloud raw exports confirmed a PR-head Security Rating D gate failure. The finding is active remediation; scanner configuration, suppression, and risk acceptance are not authorized.

Public/default allocation and global umask reliance were removed. The repair additionally rejects cross-UID-replaceable ancestors. Focused Python, Clang/GCC C17, shell/runtime, hardened, ASan+UBSan, and GCC -fanalyzer controls passed. The finding is fixed locally, pending exact-head SonarCloud reanalysis.

Exact-head check 87949565401 closed 14 task-owned issues and left only python:S5443 at the inherited TMPDIR fallback. The final source follow-up requires TRAEFIK_ENGINE_SOCKET_PARENT, and 16 focused Python contracts plus changed-pair bilingual validation passed. The finding remains fixed locally pending a new exact-head SonarCloud reanalysis.

The canonical stage dispatcher, remaining-target runner, and native Make target now forward only the caller-supplied explicit parent. Fresh focused source, wiring, documentation, and Make-dry-run validation passed; a derived canonical runtime or temporary-root parent was deliberately rejected because it exceeds the UDS path budget.
The EN/DE Change Record was synchronized with the final forwarding validation, and its changed-pair checker rerun passed. The finding remains fixed locally pending exact-head SonarCloud reanalysis.

The earlier log 150 was non-hostile forwarding evidence only. FND-PARENT-0019 records the separately reproduced Make/shell interpretation defect; raw environment forwarding and focused hostile-input controls passed in log 159. This finding remains fixed locally pending exact-head SonarCloud reanalysis.

The named lifecycle-forwarded BUILD_ROOT, MODSECURITY, and Traefik values were all verified literal through the Make boundary; no marker executed and 22 focused contracts passed. FND-PARENT-0019 records the shared interpretation-root-cause closure. This finding remains fixed locally pending exact-head SonarCloud reanalysis.
